name: v4.0.546
body:
## What's Changed

- `@remotion/studio`: **Add effects to any element!** by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13443
- [`@remotion/cli`: Add `npx remotion whisper` commands for local transcription and model management](https://remotion.dev/docs/cli/whisper) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13554
- [`@remotion/studio`: Add a double-click action setting for layers, effects, and properties](https://remotion.dev/docs/options/double-click-action) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13576
- `remotion`: Keep `<IFrame>` mounted on audio-only frames by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13520
- `@remotion/cli`: Remove the Bun startup notice by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13556
- [`@remotion/cli`: Detect OpenTimelineIO import frame rate and dimensions](https://remotion.dev/docs/opentimeline) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13383
- `@remotion/eslint-config-flat`: Fix minimatch vulnerability in lint dependencies by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13575
- `@remotion/media`: Fix errors escaping media input disposal by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13537
- `@remotion/media`: Fix canvas memory growth in Safari previews by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13555
- `@remotion/player`: Fix `<Html5Audio>` going silent after remounting by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13544
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix audio render crash when `toneFrequency` is low by @gongfpp in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13518
- `@remotion/studio`: Preserve layer dimensions when wrapping in a canvas by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13527
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix timeline flicker when toggling Audio Levels by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13551
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix viewport culling of transformed masked groups by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13416
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix rounded corner clipping in Firefox by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13425
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fall back when native canvas paint times out by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13460
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Preserve native WebKit SVG text colors by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13502

## Docs

- [Add "Which license do I need?" quiz](https://remotion.dev/docs/license/which-license) by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13138
- [Explain how to use Remotion Elements first](https://remotion.dev/docs/elements/creating) by @flipcyde101 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13545
- Add make.pictures to resources by @pawelbart in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13293
- Use Play/Pause buttons to toggle demo playback by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13521
- Update HTML-in-canvas Chrome support by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13549
- 5.0 Terms: Use stronger wording for company license requirement: "qualify for Company License" -> "do not qualify for the Free License" in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13539

## Internal and Experimental

- Isolate audio render retries by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13500
- Compare native PNG channels before canvas conversion by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13505
- Run web renderer browser projects sequentially by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13516
- Use a local HTTP fixture for the renderer download test by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13523
- Prepare the browser before SSR test deadlines by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13524
- Await streamed Lambda test handler cleanup by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13533
- Split packaged Lambda launch tests by output scenario by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13536
- remotion.dev/brand: Polish the Motion Blur promo and use GitHub Dark for code visuals by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13517

## New Contributors

- @pawelbart made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13293

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.545...v4.0.546
